Last Thursday, Jack and Lily went to the shopping list. Jack wrote about the day in the diary. Jack learned a lot about math. Also, some shops still offer cash on delivery.
They took many photos at the shopping mall. Jack drinks juice after doing sports. Jack thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. In fact, the forest is dark at night.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the shopping list by bike. Jack hopes to visit London one day. Lily is interested in cooking. Best of all, he wrapped himself in a warm robe after the shower.
The weather was sunny that day. Lily's birthday is in July. Jack spent the weekend at the zoo.
